We propose BackPlay, a frozen-backbone self-correction framework that trains only a lightweight correction head on a finetuned DLM without updating any backbone or adapter parameters. Because the head is trained on errors produced by the same frozen generator used at inference time, its training distribution aligns with the error patterns of the deployed model.
